column1: # C101 align slot table (camp-align.sh / run-align.sh read it; generated by mkslots.py, hand edits allowed). Slots run in FILE ORDER =
#   the staging order; the time phase re-reads this file before every slot, so later lines can be added, removed or reordered
#   mid-run (finished slots keep state/<slot>.align; delete a line = cut that slot).
# Slot names: <row> = BASE + FULL (FULL table); p05-<row> = pilot: the same 16 images (copies of bld/<row>) timed with 0.5-s JMH

#   iterations (the row itself runs 0.2 s), nb 1 = the b1 image of each config (set 2 for all 16 images, ~2x the time); pr-<row> = BASE + SBS + SV + LS (per-rep tables, each config against the BASE timed in
#   the same slot, as C100 tier B; BASE images = copies of bld/<row>'s BASE builds).
# Tiers: W wins FULL (cheapest first) + p05 pilots, P per-rep of wins, D DaCapo (FULL, then pr-dacapo-batik), S snakeyaml, N other
#   neutral rows (closest to a class boundary first), PN pr-antlr, C proposed cut candidates.
# Columns 1-12 as cycle100/final/slots.tsv (slot tier proto raised spr nb rpb cfgs rows cpus reuse align) + 13 iter:
#   cfgs = each config at CodeAlignment 64 (plain name) / 32 / 128 / 256; nb 2 = 2 real builds per config and alignment = 8 images
#   per config; rpb = process starts per image (NSTART forced to 1): 1, or 4 for single-shot rows; reuse none = all new builds,
#   else REUSE_FROM (copies); align "-"; cpus "-" = cpus.tsv (0-15); iter = JMH iteration length (200ms | 500ms | 1s | - = non-JMH
# C101 orchestrator decisions 2026-11-11 (backup: slots.tsv.pre-cut): CUT minimal-json java-json-benchmark antlr lucene-jmh pr-antlr
#   (records below, commented); pr-guava + pr-lucene-bytask moved to the END as tier O (optional: run only if time remains);
#   dacapo-sunflow column 10 = 4,6 (C100 2-core exception, XU1; JVM sanity reference re-keys on CPUS)
